text:
Nina Cho: Quick callout 1723: recent optimize toolkit PRs introduced a mismatch: Python snippets are fine, but Go and Rust examples reference old quant profile keys and a deprecated client constructor. CI samplegen flagged two failing examples.
Arman Patel: Thanks, Nina. I can take Go. Looks like OldClient -> rd.NewClient and quant profile map keys changed from "q_profile" to "quant_profile". I'll update examples and add a migration note.
Lydia Park: I'll tackle Rust and the docs anchor issues. The quant-profiles page changed its heading to "Quant Profiles and DTypes" so anchors moved. I propose adding short redirect comments in the affected MD files rather than updating every legacy link.
doc-bot: [automated] samplegen results: branch docs/optkit-fix shows failures: optimize/kv-prefetch.md (go), optimize/quant-profiles.md (anchor mismatch). Logs: https://ci.internal.redwood/ci/12345/logs
Arman Patel: Patch pushed: replaced constructor example with `client := rd.NewClient(ctx, rd.WithAPIKey(envKey))` and updated imports. Also changed map key examples to use "quant_profile". PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4277
Lydia Park: Drafted small anchor redirect notes in kv-prefetch.md and added a TOC anchor in quant-profiles.md. Also added a one-liner in optimize/migration.md: "If you relied on q_profile keys or OldClient, see migration examples." PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4278
Nina Cho: Can someone run samplegen locally and add a unit compile check for Go snippets? We keep regressing on constructor changes.
Arman Patel: Added examples/test_examples.go compile check and ran samplegen v0.4.2 locally 1723: all green. Requested review.
Lydia Park: Ran a quick link checker and fixed two stray internal links. Previewed docs site and the redirect notices look good.
doc-bot: [automated] CI re-run for PRs #4277 and #4278 queued.
Nina Cho: Thanks! Once CI is green, please merge and file a DOCS follow-up to sweep other optimize examples for constructor/anchor regressions.
Arman Patel: Filed DOCS-849 and assigned to docs-rotation.
Lydia Park: :thumbsup: closing thread after merges.
